item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows Karan's square card of side $8\,\mathrm{cm}$ with centre marked $O$. He wants a circular hole of radius $2\,\mathrm{cm}$ at that centre, drawn with a compass.

Which claim correctly states where the compass point must sit and what radius to use?

options.A: Place the compass point at $O$ and set the radius to $2\,\mathrm{cm}$.
options.B: Place the compass point anywhere on the card; only the $2\,\mathrm{cm}$ opening matters.
options.C: Place the compass point on the dashed circle and set the radius from there to $O$.
options.D: Draw the hole freehand, because neat artwork on the square card is enough.
